scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(!fs.existsSync('dist')){fs.mkdirSync('dist'); ['index.html','admin.html','404.html','_redirects','package.json'].forEach(f=>{if(fs.existsSync(f))fs.copyFileSync(f,'dist/'+f)}); ['assets','images','admin','functions'].forEach(d=>{if(fs.existsSync(d))fs.cpSync(d,'dist/'+d,{recursive:true})}); console.log('dist output created successfully');}"
